_about: 1-Butanol (1) + Ethyl acetate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 300.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-butanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 1-butanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).
